title: Three Years and One Short Staff
subtitle: 品格修养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）
meta: 主题语境：品格修养（人与自我·做人与做事·优秀品行与道德品质）　|　核心词汇：personality　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 personality 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1994 the elder ① showed the personality that no youth in the village would have counted, and he said the showing was the whole of the year. The ② personality, meaning the character itself and not the staff, ran three years and stayed uncounted in the book; a personality, he said, is the only thing in a village that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ personality in that village had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ personality at the far gate, meaning the hope they kept for the children to keep and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A personality, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the elder said the counting is the part that fills three years.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the personality was the whole of the matter, meaning the charm and not the character. The ⑥ personality, meaning the charm and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; personality, he said, is either something you show or the only word that means both a character and a charm. He said the charm is the part they remember.

By 1999 the ⑦ personality had become a line in a memoir, and the memoir had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ personality of the whole thing, the elder wrote in November, was one village and three years of counting; personality, he said, is either the hope at the far gate or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ personality I remember is the character counted in the memoir, which closed in 2001 and is still counted as the quietest in the village. A ⑩ personality, my mother said in 2003, is the only character that improves by being counted; every personality, she said, is a charm that has agreed to look like a character. She said the charm was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 个性；品格（指村子里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 个性；品格（指那种个性本身，与短短的拐杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：show the personality 显出这一种个性
D. n. 个性；品格（指留给孩子们守着的那一个）
E. n. 个性之事（抽象总称，指一处村子的个性之事）
F. n. 个性；品格（指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一种）
G. n. 个性、风采（指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 风采（抽象总称，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: showed the personality that no youth in the village would have counted
The personality, meaning the character itself and not the staff
the personality at the far gate
the personality was the whole of the matter
the personality had become a line in a memoir
The personality of the whole thing
A personality, my mother said in 2003

answers.why: show the personality 意为“显出这一种个性”，1994 年那位长者把村子里没有一位后生肯清点的一种个性做了一遍。
personality 意为“个性；品格”，指那种个性本身而不是短短的拐杖，它经过了三个年头而在簿子上没有被清点。
personality 意为“个性；品格”，指村子里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一根短短的拐杖。
personality 意为“个性；品格”，指最远那道村口的留给孩子们守着的那一个，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
personality 意为“个性、风采”，指一件事里人人都想却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种风采就是那件事的全部。
personality 意为“风采”，指人人都想却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种个性，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
personality 意为“个性；品格”，指回忆录里写到、被清点的那一种，到 1999 年这一种成了回忆录里的一行。
personality 意为“个性之事”，长者十一月写道，整件事的个性之事是一处村子和三个年头的清点。
personality 意为“个性；品格”，我记得的是回忆录里清点过的那一种，2001 年想通了，至今仍被说成村子里最安静的一种。
personality 为抽象总称，母亲 2003 年说，个性是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的个性。
